prompt:
# Scimitar: paint + material mask view atlas

Scope: image generation only. Write ONLY into `level_generation/props/items_mm9_claude/codex_tex/d10018/`. Do not edit any other file, do not run builds.

Inputs (attached):
- `paint_mask_guide.png`: 1536x2048 transparent sheet, three columns by FOUR rows of 512x512 cells. Rows 1-2 and rows
  3-4 hold the same five grey orthographic renders of the exact 3D model: FRONT, BACK, LEFT / RIGHT, TOP, empty.

Task: use your built-in image generation tool to paint the guide sheet. Output ONE PNG with a transparent background
and a 3:4 canvas (1536x2048 or the tool's nearest 3:4 size), the same layout, each object in exactly the same position,
size and outline as its grey guide. Paint the grey objects only; never redraw, enlarge, move or redesign them.

- Rows 1-2 (PAINT): the unlit base colour of the item on each view: Faithfully repaint the exact isolated and mechanically rotated MM9 Scimitar PCX as an MM6-MM8-style inventory sprite without redesigning it. Preserve its broad dramatically swept pale-steel blade and convex cutting edge, muted brass guard with curled tips, short dark grip, and vivid green pommel cap. Render one complete vertical sword with restrained late-1990s realism and genuine transparent alpha. No narrow straight blade, orange knuckle bow, missing green accent, generic replacement, text, glow, shadow, frame, or watermark..
- Rows 3-4 (MATERIAL MASK): the same five silhouettes filled with FLAT pure colours only, no shading, no texture, no
  outlines, no antialiased colour blends inside:
  - pure red #FF0000: every metal part (steel, iron, chain mail, gold, silver, bronze, copper, brass)
  - pure green #00FF00: every leather part (straps, padding, hide, suede) and fur
  - pure blue #0000FF: every cloth part (tabards, quilting, linings, cords, ribbons) and hair
  - pure yellow #FFFF00: every matte non-metal solid (wood, bone, horn, stone, parchment, paper, wax)
  - pure black #000000: every gemstone, crystal, glass, pearl, enamel or liquid seen through glass
  Every pixel of each silhouette gets exactly one of these colours; nothing outside the silhouettes.
- `design_reference.png`: the approved HD painting or master of the item, the material and detail reference.
- `icon_x8.png`: the original game icon (magenta is background), the colour reference.

Object: Faithfully repaint the exact isolated and mechanically rotated MM9 Scimitar PCX as an MM6-MM8-style inventory sprite without redesigning it. Preserve its broad dramatically swept pale-steel blade and convex cutting edge, muted brass guard with curled tips, short dark grip, and vivid green pommel cap. Render one complete vertical sword with restrained late-1990s realism and genuine transparent alpha. No narrow straight blade, orange knuckle bow, missing green accent, generic replacement, text, glow, shadow, frame, or watermark.

- Facets, engravings, scrollwork and inner swirls follow the design reference, scaled to each view.
- Keep every gap and opening exactly as in the guide and fully transparent.
- Unlit base colour only: no lighting, no cast shadows, no ambient occlusion, no hot highlights or reflections, no
  glow halo, sparkles or aura outside the silhouette, no ground, no outlines, no text.
- The empty cells (column 3 of row 2 and row 4) stay empty and transparent.

Save the generated image (copy the file the tool produced) to `level_generation/props/items_mm9_claude/codex_tex/d10018/paint_mask_raw_v1.png` and write
`generation_paint.json` (prompt, inputs with sha256, original output path, output, size). At most one corrective
regeneration, only if the silhouettes or layout are clearly wrong.

Input order: image 1 paint_mask_guide.png is the EDIT TARGET, preserve its exact layout and silhouettes. Image 2 design_reference.png is material/detail reference only. Image 3 icon_x8.png is colour reference only. Output the complete atlas, not a single sword. Gem pommel in mask rows is opaque pure black, leather grip pure green, blade/guard/fittings pure red. Preserve all ten separate view silhouettes and the two empty cells.
CORRECTION: The previous attempt introduced jagged protrusions and stray pixels around objects. Strictly retain the original guide silhouettes with clean continuous edges, no speckles, no added bumps, no outline strokes, no stray marks anywhere. Paint ONLY inside original guide shapes. The thin side views must remain thin exactly as the guide, guards retain angular guide geometry. Use flat unlit paint without bright specular reflections. Mask silhouettes must be completely solid flat pure material colors with clean boundaries.
validation_notes: Layout retained; visible edge artifacts remain after the one allowed correction. Raw tool output preserved unchanged.
